title: The mind makes the Process 1 choice

statements.text: The choice of the operator $P$, which Stapp calls the Heisenberg Choice, is fixed neither by the Schrodinger equation nor by nature's answer, so it is most naturally fixed by the experiential part of the observing system. The only power the theory gives the mind is the power to choose the questions.
